page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance engineered for workloads demanding dedicated core allocation and multi-threaded processing power. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 35 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The server type includes 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, zero local storage, and no hardware accelerators.

Benchmark data reflects the capabilities of the Broadwell-generation Intel processor. In multi-threaded execution, the instance attains middle-tier performance, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 5,741.0, a PassMark CPU score of 13,034.32, and a stress-ng multi-core measurement of 11,775.91. Conversely, single-threaded throughput falls in the lower tiers, registering 930.0 on Geekbench single-core and 1,108.79 on stress-ng single-core. Memory bandwidth tests yield 75.27 GB/sec read and 55.21 GB/sec write on large blocks. Application-specific benchmarks demonstrate 11.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.81 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge trades cutting-edge per-thread execution speed for predictable multi-threaded capacity on dedicated CPU threads. The absence of built-in local NVMe storage requires external block storage attachment, shifting the input/output cost profile to remote volumes. Workloads that depend heavily on single-thread frequency or ultra-fast decompression may encounter architectural bottlenecks. However, tasks that divide evenly across 16 threads—such as static web serving, Clang compilation, multi-threaded compression, and mid-tier backend processing—remain stable fits for this configuration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Built on the x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 architecture operating at 2.5 GHz, it allocates 8 physical cores across two threads per core. The instance provides 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, no integrated local storage, and zero GPUs. Benchmark measurements reflect average multi-core processing with a Geekbench score of 5,741.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 13,034.32, countered by lower single-core metrics such as a 930.0 Geekbench single-thread result. Data throughput highlights include 11.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 7.81 GB/sec static web serving bandwidth. This profile is engineered for parallel batch processing, software compilation, multi-threaded caching layers, and web application serving that do not depend on high single-threaded clock speed.
